name: Phantasm
description: 'Phantasm' is where That Boy Hi Hat's post-trap futurism goes full neon-noir. A deep cut from Idol or Icon (2021), the track rides an 88 BPM pulse through flickering synths and sub-bass pressure that evokes a city at night rendered in neon — dystopian but magnetic, the sound of a future you can't look away from. His delivery is cool and coiled, riding the beat rather than fighting it, which makes the record hypnotic: it pulls you into its circuitry and holds you there. Behind the scenes, the production history tells its own story — the vault's alternate master was running hot with true-peak clipping, and a September 2026 limiter pass brought it down to a clean -0.5 dBTP, letting the darkness of the mix breathe without distortion. It's a detail only engineers would hear, but it shows how carefully That Boy Hi Hat's team treats the catalog's sonic margins. In alternative rap terms, 'Phantasm' is a scene-setter rather than a statement piece: futuristic, nocturnal, and deliberately unresolved, the kind of track that soundtracks a drive more than a headline. Within the post trap lane, it's one of his most atmospheric builds — proof that the cyberpunk impulse in his music is an aesthetic commitment, not a costume.
